blocks.text: Endosymbiotic theory Lynn Margulis ne pesh ki. Is ke mutabiq bare prokaryotes ne chhote prokaryotes ko nigla jo hazam nahi hue balke bare cells ke andar reh kar organelles mein badal gaye. Saathiyon ne aisa symbiotic rishta banaya jis se dono ko faida hua.

items: Kuch chhote prokaryotes aerobic respiration kar sakte the; unhon ne apne aur bare cell ko tawanai di aur mitochondria ban gaye.
Doosre chhote cells dhoop se khana bana kar bare cell ke saath baant'te the; woh chloroplasts ban gaye.
Flagella shayad spirochaetes jaise prokaryotes ko nigalne se aaye (yeh zyada ikhtilafi tajweez hai).

blocks.alt: Baen: DNA wala bara prokaryote jis ki taraf aik chhota surkh aerobic bacterium aur aik chhota hara photosynthetic bacterium aa rahe hain. 'Nigla gaya, hazam nahi hua' likha teer eukaryotic cell tak jata hai jis mein nucleus, endoplasmic reticulum, surkh mitochondrion aur hara chloroplast hai. Dabba saboot ginwata hai.
blocks.caption: Endosymbiosis aur eukaryotic cells ki ibtida (Figure 24.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Lynn Margulis ke endosymbiotic nazariye ke mutabiq bare prokaryotes ne chhote prokaryotes ko hazam kiye baghair nigal liya, aur dono dono ke faide ke liye saath rehne lage. Aerobic respiration karne wale chhote cells ne tawanai di aur mitochondria ban gaye; dhoop se khana banane wale chhote cells chloroplasts ban gaye. Saboot: mitochondria aur chloroplasts prokaryotes jitne bare hain, un ka apna prokaryotic chromosome jaisa gol DNA hai, binary fission se taqseem hote hain, aur un ki membranes prokaryotes jaisi hain. Membrane invagination nazariya mazeed kehta hai ke cell membrane ke andar murne se nucleus aur endoplasmic reticulum jaisi andaruni membranes banin.

blocks.text: Endosymbiosis se bane eukaryotic cells taqatwar aur mo'assar the, jis se un mein kaseer-ul-khaliyat, cells ki takhassus aur bare size jaisi nayi khasiyatein ban sakin; yahi aaj ke janwaron, paudon aur phaphoondon ke wasee tanawwu ki kunji the.

blocks.title: Endosymbiotic theory ke saboot
blocks.text: Mitochondria aur chloroplasts prokaryotic cells jitne bare hain; un ka apna DNA prokaryotes jaise gol chromosome mein hai; yeh prokaryotes ki tarah binary fission se barhte hain, jab ke eukaryotic cells mitosis se taqseem hote hain; aur un ki membranes eukaryotic ke bajaye prokaryotic membranes se zyada milti hain.

blocks.title: Membrane invagination theory
blocks.text: Aik aur nazariya kehta hai ke prokaryotic cell ki membrane cytoplasm mein andar ki taraf muri jis se nucleus aur endoplasmic reticulum jaise membrane wale dhaanche, aur yun eukaryotic cell, bana. Kitab ka aakhri jumla kehta hai ke is se 'prokaryotic cell' bana; matlab eukaryotic cell hai.

blocks.prompt: Do saboot dein ke mitochondria kabhi azad rehne wale bacteria the.
blocks.explanation: Koi do: bacteria jitna size; apna gol DNA; binary fission se taqseem; prokaryotes jaisi membranes.

items: Margulis: nigle aerobic bacteria mitochondria aur photosynthetic chloroplasts bane.
Saboot: size, gol DNA, binary fission, prokaryote jaisi membranes.
Membrane invagination: andar murne se nucleus aur ER bane.
